title: Preserve revised source versions and disprove automatic vorticity/common-driver transfer
statement: At the supplied root-read scopes,2004.07528v3 Thms1–2 use vorticity and an epsilon-mass exceptional initial set for any prescribed measure, explicitly revising v1 all-initial wording.2607.15140v4 Eq1.1/Def3.1/Thm4.1/Cor4.3/10.2 uses native velocity transport noise with pressure/Leray projection and per-initial high probability/sup_u0 probabilities. Neither supplies one deterministic driver good for every initial profile, and qualitative convergence does not pay a finite synthesis cutoff. Algebraically curl P[(b.grad)u]=(b.grad)omega+epsilon_kli*(partial_l b_j)*(partial_j u_i), so vorticity and native transport differ. Even P(G_u)=1 for each u does not ensure a common driver: G_u=[0,1] minus{u} has empty total intersection. Finite-net/Wong–Zakai transfer needs paid uniform strong stability/continuation margins. These are scope/transfer obstructions, not a full control no-go.
